name: Cucumber Mosaic Virus
description: A widely distributed viral disease affecting cucumber and many other crops. It causes mosaic patterns, leaf distortion, and stunted growth. CMV is transmitted by aphids and has an extremely wide host range.
symptoms: Yellow and green mosaic pattern on leaves
Leaf distortion, blistering, and reduced size
Stunted plant growth with shortened internodes
Plants may show general chlorosis and wilting
causes: Transmitted by multiple aphid species in non-persistent manner
Extremely wide host range including weeds and ornamentals
Infected seeds in some cucurbit species
treatments: Control aphid vectors with insecticidal soap or neem oil
Use reflective mulches to repel aphids
prevention: Control weeds that serve as virus reservoirs
Use floating row covers to exclude aphids during early growth
